title: iOS notification polish
lede: Clearer delivery settings, readable messages, and reliable recovery when the connection fails.

sections.heading: After-only simulator evidence
sections.note: iPhone 16 Pro, iOS 26.5. The inbox uses XXX Large text and a simulated failed refresh. Settings uses the existing paused-account fixture; its missing preference endpoint deliberately remains visible as a reloadable error. No matched comparison is claimed: the existing fixture clock changes between captures, and the inbox fixture was added during this pass.

changes.was: Concurrent actions could restore stale snapshots after a failed response.
changes.now: Writes serialize, update after success, and reread the server after uncertainty. Large-inbox Undo respects the API request limit.

changes.was: Bodies stopped after two lines, banners covered rows, and large text truncated the title.
changes.now: Full messages wrap, feedback reserves space, and the labeled bulk-read icon preserves the title.

changes.h: Delivery language describes what is known
changes.was: Registration read Ready, the test implied delivery, and the primer promised unsupported broadcasts.
changes.now: Settings identifies quiet delivery and registration separately. Test success means Apple accepted the push. Primer copy matches implemented producers.

changes.h: Reminders and broadcasts retain their destination
changes.was: Repeated snooze identifiers nested, scheduling could race sign-out, and blast inbox payloads lost their destination.
changes.now: Reminders retain routing context and stable identifiers with session cleanup. Blast archive taps return to the Home acknowledgment banner.

verification: 120 notification and transport contract tests passed across 19 files.

Eight native notification tests passed on the required iPhone 16 Pro in an isolated copy, including committed-write/lost-response recovery, duplicate action protection, paging overlap, 1,001-item undo, snooze identity, blast decoding and rendered recovery.
Wisconsin app compiled for the simulator; existing notification-settings UI test passed. TypeScript, focused lint, documentation verification and diff whitespace checks passed.
notes: The normal native test bundle is blocked by pre-existing ScheduleDateMathTests fixture initializer errors. Focused tests used an isolated copy with only NotificationInboxTests in the test target; product notification sources are unchanged between that copy and this checkout.

No real push was sent. Physical lock-screen delivery, permission changes, snooze execution, blast acknowledgment, authenticated lifecycle and VoiceOver acceptance remain unverified. No commit, deployment or distribution was performed.
